scenario: Refund case: an established activity registered in May 2019, whose 2024 net was 20,000, so no minoración, and no employment. The taxpayer expected a strong year and chose a base of 3,190.00 for January to June, 1,001.66 a month; Q1 and Q2 are closed at 6,000 and 12,000 invoiced and 3,304.98 and 6,609.96 spent, the 3,004.98 and 6,009.96 of those cuotas included. From July the base is lowered to 1,209.15, 379.67 a month. The projection for July to December is 13,000 of invoices and 600 of expenses besides the cuota. The year settles on General 4, whose base máxima of 1,850.00 is below the year's average base of 2,199.58, so TGSS refunds the year down to the cuotas at that base (LGSS art. 308.1.c 4.ª, RD 2064/1995 art. 46.2 5.ª c) and the estimate must not reserve the refund (#55).

setAside.oracleRef: Arithmetic under the set-aside composition rules of #10 and #15, computed on 2026-09-27 by an independent Decimal script written from those rules and the sources below, not by running the engine: the #52 script, which first reproduced every expected value of the 2025 set-aside goldens on main under the #52 rule (154 values) and then took the #55 rule, written by the #55 owner from LGSS art. 308.1 before reading the engine change; the tipo is taken from the Orden, not from the config under test. The #55 owner also wrote the design the engine implements, so the script is independent of the engine's code but not of its designer. A first version clamped the closed months together and each projected month on its own; review found that RGC art. 46.2 regularises one average of the whole year, and the pooled rule was written into the script from the regla text before the engine was changed. It left every value but G20's unchanged, and the reviewer's separate script agrees on G15 and G20. Actuals are the cumulative closed quarters; the projection is spread evenly over the months after the last of them. TGSS (#39, #52, #55): LGSS art. 308.1 (boe.es consolidated RDL 8/2015, block a308, read 2026-09-27). The taxpayer chooses a monthly base (a) 1.ª and 3.ª) and TGSS debits it times the tipos (b)): 31.40 % in 2025, 28.30 contingencias comunes + 1.30 profesionales + 0.80 MEI (Orden PJC/178/2025 art. 18.2, BOE-A-2025-3780) + 0.90 cese de actividad + 0.10 formación profesional (art. 37.5–37.6), rounded half up to the cent. Those debits are the cuotas the year's return deducts, so casilla 0186 is what was paid to June plus what is debited after it, and the projected gastos carry the same debits. The rendimiento computable is the IRPF rendimiento neto plus the titular's own cuotas (c) 1.ª), less 7 % gastos genéricos (2.ª, config seguridadSocial.gastosGenericos), spread over the months of alta (3.ª). The net is Modelo 100 casilla 0224 and the cuotas casilla 0186 (AEAT, Información para determinar el rendimiento neto, sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es, page updated 18 Sep 2026, read 2026-09-27); casilla 0224 is after difícil justificación (RD 439/2007 art. 30.2ª: 5 %, at most 2,000) and before every LIRPF art. 32 reduction and the other reductions Modelo 100 2025 takes after it, in casillas 0225, 0232–0234 and 0236–0237 (Anexo I, página 9), so the art. 32.3 reduction does not lower it. The debits do not depend on the tramo, so one computable follows and one tramo contains it. TGSS then regularises the year as a whole (c) 3.ª–4.ª and RD 2064/1995 art. 46.2, boe.es BOE-A-1996-1579 block a46, version in force from 2024-08-01, read 2026-09-27): regla 3.ª sums the provisional bases of the year's months less the tarifa plana days (1.ª), divides by those days and multiplies by 30; regla 5.ª compares that one average base with the tramo's base mínima and base máxima. Between them nothing moves (5.ª a); below or above, TGSS reclaims or refunds the total of the differences between each month's base and the base mínima or máxima (5.ª b and c), at the period's tipo (7.ª). A whole month counts 30 days, as RGC art. 45.1 prorates the cuota, so the average lies below the base mínima exactly when the year's debits total less than the cuotas at it, and TGSS keeps the year's debits, closed and projected months pooled, clamped between the cuotas at the tramo's base mínima and base máxima summed over those months; tarifa plana months are not regularised (Ley 20/2007 art. 38 ter.6) and stay as debited. Modelo 130: AEAT instrucciones del modelo 130 (sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es, page updated 11 Sep 2026, read 2026-09-26), casillas 01–19, and RD 439/2007 art. 30.2ª and 110 (difícil justificación in casilla 02; casilla 12 floors 07 at zero; casilla 14 = 12 − 13 may be negative; casilla 15 deducts earlier negative casilla 19 results, at most a positive casilla 14). Annual: SPEC-002 steps 1, 2, 4 and 6, LIRPF art. 19, 20, 30.2.4ª, 32.3, 56, 63 and 74, VC mínimo 6,105 (Ley 13/1997 art. 2 bis). Hold-back share (Σ 130 + gap + the year's cuotas SS that TGSS keeps) / annual ingresos, rounded up to 0.0001. No AEAT simulator, published example or gestor covers a set-aside estimate; this is the weakest gate. The refund case of LGSS art. 308.1.c 4.ª, párrafo segundo: the taxpayer chose 3,190.00 for January to June, General 8's base máxima, 3,190.00 × 0.314 = 1,001.66 a month, and lowered it to 1,209.15 from July, 1,209.15 × 0.314 = 379.667 → 379.67. Q1 as stated: 6,000 − (3,304.98 + 134.7510) = 2,560.27, 20 % 512.05, no minoración (2024 net 20,000 is above every band), pays 512.05. Q2 as stated: 12,000 − (6,609.96 + 269.502) = 5,120.54, 20 % 1,024.11 − 512.05 = 512.06. Q3 to date: 12,000 + 13,000 × 3 / 6 = 18,500; 6,609.96 + 300 + 3 × 379.67 = 8,048.97; difícil justificación 522.5515; casilla 03 9,928.48; 20 % 1,985.70 − 1,024.11 = 961.59, due 1–20 October. Q4 961.58. Σ 130 2,947.28. TGSS: annual gastos 6,609.96 + 600 + 6 × 379.67 = 9,487.98, previo 15,512.02, difícil justificación 775.601, casilla 0224 14,736.419, plus 6,009.96 paid and 2,278.02 debited after June = 23,024.399, × 0.93 / 12 = 1,784.3909225 a month, General 4 (1,700 to 1,850). General 4's cuotas are 359.15 at its base mínima of 1,143.79 and 1,850.00 × 0.314 = 580.90 at its base máxima (config seguridadSocial.tramos). No month is under tarifa plana. The year's average base is (6 × 3,190.00 + 6 × 1,209.15) / 12 = 2,199.575, above General 4's base máxima of 1,850.00, so the definitive base is 1,850.00 in every month (RGC art. 46.2 5.ª c). The year debits 6,009.96 paid to June + 6 × 379.67 = 2,278.02 after it = 8,287.98, and TGSS keeps 12 × 580.90 = 6,970.80 and refunds 1,317.18 (0.314 × the 4,194.90 of base differences is 1,317.20; the two cents are the rounding of each month's cuota). The year's cuotas SS are 6,970.80, and TGSS debits 379.67 a month. A first #55 version clamped the closed months alone, refunding them down to 6 × 580.90 = 3,485.40, and left the months after June at 379.67 each: 5,763.42 and a share of 0.3485. Under #52 the closed months counted the 6,009.96 paid in full, since the higher of paid and priced took no account of the refund, and the six months after June were priced at 359.15: 8,164.86 for the year and a share of 0.4455. Annual: 25,000 − 9,487.98 = 15,512.02, difícil justificación 775.601, net 14,736.419; no employment, so the base is the net: cuota 929.87028 estatal + 858.92028 VC = 1,788.79056, below the 2,947.28 of advances, gap 0. Share (2,947.28 + 0 + 6,970.80) / 25,000 = 0.3967232, rounded up 0.3968. Due window (#40): RD 439/2007 art. 111.1 and Orden EHA/672/2007 art. 7 give 1–20 of the month, and a last day that is a Saturday, Sunday or holiday of the taxpayer's region moves to the next working day (Orden EHA/672/2007 art. 7; Ley 39/2015 art. 30.5–30.6; boe.es, read 2026-09-27); 20 October 2025 is a Monday and no holiday in the Comunitat Valenciana (BOE-A-2024-26935), so it stands.
